title: Environment memory observation and availability
description: Bytes within one verified task container or exclusive execution cgroup. Total is the sampled maximum strictly after the action start and no later than its completion event; extra=max(0,total-baseline). Baseline is the latest sample at or before action start, at most 150ms old. At least one in-window sample is required and no boundary or consecutive sampling gap may exceed 150ms. Overlapping monitored environment calls are ineligible. The environment includes background processes and charged cache; extra is incremental environment usage, not exclusive allocation by a process. Host service cgroups and post-completion samples are excluded. RSS is diagnostic only. Unavailable observations carry memory_eligible=false and memory_unavailable_reason instead of these eligible labels.
